scope: One end-of-local-UI controller processing pass; produced followups remain outside the frozen snapshot.

findings.title: Keep header sync states readable with enlarged phone text
findings.observation: MainLayout emits failed, stale, cloud-syncing and timestamp labels. The phone slot is bounded by25vw and sync-chip applies nowrap/hidden ellipsis. Current360/200 native screenshots still expose only a prefix. Shared header/main clearance and compact navigation outcomes preserve access but do not establish complete status wording.
findings.goal: Expose a complete understandable sync-state label or concise summary with full detail available through an accessible explicit path, while retaining menu and Refresh access.
criteria: Complete sync-state wording remains understandable for fresh, failed, stale and busy states with long times and enlarged phone text.
Menu and Refresh retain44-pixel targets, visible focus and access; full status/time detail is available without relying only on hover.
Current light/dark phone/desktop rendered geometry and native disclosure behavior qualify without changing sync decisions.
findings.constraints: Presentation only. Preserve status precedence, refresh ownership, busy guards and cache decisions. Do not weaken fonts, contrast, controls or qualification to hide clipping.

findings.title: Diagnose and stabilize sign-in overlap in gear-recovery cancellation checks
findings.observation: RecoverySetup awaits SignInAsync, while CompleteSignInRefreshAsync continues through an unawaited background path. Recovery refuses State.IsBusy before acquiring the recovery lease. The original119-test prerequisite failed once before browser launch; the observed guard result does not establish a production cause.
findings.goal: Establish deterministic synthetic readiness and controlled interleavings around cancellation; identify a fixture race or evidence-backed application defect without weakening recovery assertions.
criteria: Controlled deferred collaborators establish the exact sign-in/background/recovery ordering and explain the observed guard failure or retain an explicit evidence-backed blocker.
Cancellation retains the original journal, releases busy/lease state, permits no duplicate equip or cast, and preserves account-change guards under deterministic interleavings.
Focused repeated controls use explicit completion barriers and preserve every original failure; no arbitrary sleep, retry-until-pass or assertion weakening establishes acceptance.
findings.constraints: Investigation precedes any production fix. Use bounded synthetic collaborators and explicit readiness signals. No live equipment, spell, credential or provider operation. An unexplained failure remains open rather than becoming a claimed production diagnosis.

findings.title: Clear stale review guidance after known unaccepted task cancellation
findings.observation: WorkspaceTaskController.CancelPreview clears Message and refuses unknown preparation/acceptance. TodoWorkspacePresentation.CancelPreview forwards cancellation without updating the copied Message; RunAsync also retains Message when the controller message becomes null. Current cancelled native previews preserve journals but leave earlier review guidance.
findings.goal: After a known unaccepted task preview is cancelled, present guidance consistent with current readiness while retaining original unknown-command fences and unrelated errors.
criteria: Known unaccepted cancellation removes obsolete review-before-saving guidance and leaves the exact journal and draft unchanged.
Unknown preparation/acceptance still refuses cancellation and retains original request, receipt and refusal guidance; completed receipts and unrelated errors are not silently erased.
Task, Today and type-copy cancellation render correct readiness and keyboard continuation across the required matrix.
findings.constraints: Update message ownership at the actual known-cancellation boundary. Preserve current controller refusal order, source authority, accepted receipts and draft isolation. No acceptance, replay or source switch is implied.

findings.title: Present concise Party sync failures with separate sanitized diagnostics
findings.observation: The Party bridge throws descriptive local-host/HTML response errors. The background sign-in error path forwards exception.Message to shared ErrorMessage and sanitized diagnostics, so JSInterop message/stack content appears in the user banner. The prior reflow repair bounds the banner but does not shorten failure copy.
findings.goal: Show concise actionable Party-sync guidance while retaining sanitized technical diagnostics separately and preserving cached Party reads and execution fences.
criteria: Local-host unavailable, HTML response, malformed JSON and transport failures produce concise classified user guidance without a raw stack or duplicated implementation details.
Sanitized diagnostics retain useful failure context without credentials, private headers or unbounded response bodies; cached Party access and sync/mutation guards remain unchanged.
Party and shared-warning surfaces remain readable with keyboard-reachable relevant actions in the required rendered matrix.
findings.constraints: Scope normalization to the Party-sync failure path. Preserve existing rate-limit, consent, account and mutation boundaries. Do not hide unrelated errors, expose response bodies or imply automatic retry or configuration changes.

findings.title: Expose complete retained title and Notes during frozen task reviews
findings.observation: TodoTaskPanel retains the exact draft title and Notes inside a disabled fieldset. A native disabled single-line title cannot offer ordinary keyboard scrolling/selection, and current360/200 captures show only a prefix. The3:1 disabled-text outcome qualifies contrast, not complete retained-value inspectability.
findings.goal: Offer complete exact retained title and Notes through a keyboard-accessible read-only presentation while editing remains fenced.
criteria: Long retained title and Notes are fully inspectable through wrapped read-only text or an equivalent keyboard-accessible disclosure while native editing remains unavailable.
Inspection preserves exact private draft values, original pending command ownership and unknown-outcome fences; account/source changes remove prior private content.
Normal/enlarged light/dark phone/desktop states qualify complete value access, visible focus, disabled refusal and safe text encoding; physical assistive-technology gaps remain explicit.
findings.constraints: Read-only presentation only. Use the current draft and active ownership context, render untrusted text safely and avoid new persistence, clipboard side effects, enabled editing or command dispatch.

evidence_limits: Source and retained original artifacts establish scoped followup work; no new defect is claimed fixed.
The gear-recovery production cause remains unknown; no source fix is assumed.
Owner-only release gates remain unresolved; no live execution or publication authority.
